g.text: ARTIE and the replies it makes
Smoke: 5 of 5 passed (S1, S2, S3, S4, S5)
: ARTIE's HEART requests to each party, numbered as the steps of its trace, and their answers
: RISE: ARTIE's replies, read until answered, and each party's signed answer to them
: the parties' own messages, which ARTIE never sees: the watch's looks, Jenkins' part
Yellow notes: the links an answer handed over; every address after an entry came from one
